title: Enhancing Software Engineering Through Closed-Loop Memory Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2606.05646v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have enabled powerful software engineering (SE) agents capable of navigating complex codebases and resolving real-world issues. However, these agents remain fundamentally episodic: they fail to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks, repeatedly reconstructing context from scratch and reproducing similar mistakes. Even with memory support, they offer no remedy for the absence of a principled, task-agnostic \textit{memory utility}, making them difficult to evaluate rigorously or generalize across agents and settings. To tackle these limitations, we introduce MemOp, a closed-loop framework for memory augmentation in SE agents. MemOp grounds memory utility in \textit{validated downstream impact}, establishing utility as both a task-agnostic \textbf{evaluation benchmark} and an annotation-free \textbf{optimization signal}. translated_title: 通过闭环记忆优化增强软件工程
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）已经催生出强大的软件工程（SE）智能体，能够浏览复杂的代码库并解决真实世界的问题。然而，这些智能体在本质上仍然是情景式的：它们无法跨任务保留、改进和复用经验，反复从零开始重建上下文，并重复犯下类似的错误。即使具备记忆支持，由于缺乏一种有原则的、与任务无关的“记忆效用”概念，这些问题也无从解决，使得它们难以被严格评估，也难以在不同智能体和设置之间进行泛化。为了解决这些局限，我们提出了MemOp，一个面向软件工程智能体记忆增强的闭环框架。MemOp将记忆效用建立在经过验证的下游影响之上，使效用既成为一个与任务无关的评估基准，又成为一种无需标注的优化信号。MemOp在四个基准测试、三种编程语言上进行了评估……
tldr: 提出MemOp闭环记忆优化框架，将记忆效用定义为经过验证的下游影响，使其同时充当与任务无关的评估基准和无需标注的优化信号，从而让软件工程智能体能够跨任务保留、改进和复用经验。
en_tdlr: MemOp is a closed-loop memory optimization framework that grounds memory utility in validated downstream impact, serving as both a task-agnostic evaluation benchmark and an annotation-free optimization signal to enable software engineering agents to retain, refine, and reuse experiences across tasks.
